verdict.rationale: YYLO is a CLI orchestrator, and API versioning with a deprecation policy is a fair question for this kind of tool. The pack shows only package version numbers (CLI 0.2.2, a 0.2.1rc6 Ledger channel) and independently versioned Skills. Nothing documents versioned APIs or any deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
